title: EcoFlow Delta Depth-of-Discharge During Outage
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecoflow:delta grid_status=off
stats min(soc_pct) as min_soc by outage_id
description: Tracks minimum EcoFlow battery SOC during each grid outage event.
value: Surfacing ecoflow delta depth-of-discharge during outage helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant home energy & solar export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you when ecoflow delta depth-of-discharge during outage matters for your routine.
